message.content:
The standalone fuzzer reads the file into a `malloc(len)` buffer. So `data[size]` would be one past the malloc'd buffer. With MSAN, reading `data[size]` would be flagged as uninitialized (or it could be a heap-buffer-overflow with ASAN). But the issue is specifically MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value.
